title: Knock Ball Off Tee
name: knock_ball_off_tee
description: A ball rests on top of a short stand on the table. A second ball rolls across the flat surface and strikes the resting ball. On impact the resting ball is knocked off the stand, launching into a short forward arc, then falls, lands on the floor and rolls to a stop. The rolling ball halts at the stand after the strike. Both balls are conserved; nothing appears or vanishes.
